externalLaunchBoundary: builtin exec -c in an already trusted Bash shell; empty env handed to the Python ELF loader before interpreter startup
grant: --grant-marker 6721129 explicit CLI argument; no inherited grant environment
trustedOSBoundary: Native executable hashes are reviewed root-owned OS snapshots, not a self-authentication claim by code already running. The script cannot undo an already executed parent/loader/Python hook. Caller must use the reviewed clean launch, trusted OS executables/shared libraries, loader config and stdlib. OS upgrades/replacements require fresh native pin verification before grant. /etc/ld.so.preload or compromised root/launcher are outside the environment-isolation guarantee.
dynamicLoader: LD_PRELOAD/LD_AUDIT/LD_LIBRARY_PATH/LD_DEBUG/GLIBC_TUNABLES and every other inherited env entry are absent before Python exec via exec-c, and absent in the Node env supplied directly to execve. -I/-S alone do not suppress ELF loader variables.
